filledRegionCertificate.argument: Each entire connected boundary is disjoint from the other, and its displayed anchor lies outside the other total control-hull box, hence has winding number zero. Winding number is constant along a disjoint connected boundary. An overlapping bounded open filled cell would have a boundary on one original curve while the other winding is nonzero there, contradicting zero winding on both boundaries. Thus the compact filled supports are disjoint; their minimum separation is attained on the boundaries and is at least the certified boundary lower bound. This applies to both nonzero and evenodd fill rules.
